ROAD TRAFFIC REGULATION ACT 1984 – SECTION 14

DEVON COUNTY COUNCIL

(uUCR 306, BERE FERRERS)

TEMPORARY PROHIBITION OF TRAFFIC ORDER 2026

NOTICE is hereby given that Devon County Council has made the above titled order.

The order came into force on Tuesday 13 January 2026 and would have expired on Sunday 12 July 2026.

By direction of the Secretary of State in exercise of his powers under Section 15(5) of the Road Traffic Regulation Act 1984 the order shall continue in force until 17 July 2027 or until works have been completed, whichever is sooner.

No vehicles, persons and/or horse riders shall proceed on the affected highway except for access to land or premises on or adjacent to that length of path.
Public rights of way affected:

uUCR 306, Bere Ferrers – to and from Lopwell Dam

Bere Ferrers uUCR306 temporary closure map

There is no alternative route.

The temporary closure is necessary in the interest of public safety following a landslide and partial collapse of the path.

Further information may be obtained by contacting Public Rights of Way on 0345 155 1004.

Dated: 19 June 2026

Rob Richards
Director of Climate Change, Environment and Transport

Public Rights of Way
Great Moor House
Bittern Road
Sowton
Exeter
EX2 7NL

ROAD TRAFFIC REGULATION ACT 1984 – SECTION 14

DEVON COUNTY COUNCIL

(uUCR 301 & 303, OFFWELL)

TEMPORARY PROHIBITION OF TRAFFIC ORDER 2026

NOTICE is hereby given that Devon County Council has made the above titled order. The above Order, which came into force on Friday 19 July 2024, and would have expired on Saturday 18 July 2026 has been extended by the Secretary of State until 18 January 2028 or until completion of the works, whichever is the sooner. No persons and/or horse riders and/or vehicles shall proceed on the affected highways except for access to land or premises on or adjacent to those lengths of highways. The order will continue in force for a period not exceeding six months or until the works have been completed, whichever is the sooner.
Highways affected:

Offwell, uUCR 301 & 303 from Little Cleave to Hayne Lane (Full length of 301 and half of 303).

Offwell uUCR 301 & 303 temporary closure map

There is no alternative route. The closure is necessary for public safety. Further information may be obtained by contacting Public Rights of Way on 0345 155 1004. Dated: 1 July 2026

Rob Richards
Director of Climate Change, Environment and Transport

Public Rights of Way
Great Moor House
Bittern Road
Sowton
Exeter

ROAD TRAFFIC REGULATION ACT 1984 – SECTION 14

DEVON COUNTY COUNCIL

(FOOTPATH No. 20, BERE FERRERS)

TEMPORARY PROHIBITION OF TRAFFIC ORDER 2026

NOTICE is hereby given that Devon County Council has made the above titled order.

From:  Tuesday 1 September 2026

To:      Monday 1 March 2027

No persons shall proceed on the section of the affected path except for access to land or premises on or adjacent to that length of path. The order will continue in force for a period not exceeding six months or until the works have been completed, whichever is the sooner.

Public right of way affected:

FOOTPATH No. 20, BERE FERRERS for a section between the east of Down View and bowling club.

Bere Ferrers Footpath 20 temporary closure map

The alternative route is via following the outer perimeter boundary line to the north of the site.

The closure is necessary for housing development and access road construction works.

Further information may be obtained by contacting Public Rights of Way on 0345 155 1004.

Dated:             3 September 2026
